items.source: Create a new instance of this strategy.

wrapper - a class which extends either directly or indirectly from Throwable and which has at least one constructor that takes a single argument of type Throwable, for example java.lang.reflect.UndeclaredThrowableException.class
items.translation: `wrapper` - 一个类，它直接地或间接地从 `Throwable` 扩展，并且至少有一个接受单个类型为 `Throwable` 的参数的构造函数，例如 `java.lang.reflect.UndeclaredThrowableException.class`。

items.source: A GeneratorStrategy suitable for use with Enhancer which causes all undeclared exceptions thrown from within a proxied method to be wrapped in an alternative exception of your choice.
items.translation: 适用于与Enhancer一起使用的GeneratorStrategy，它会导致从代理方法中抛出的所有未声明异常被包装为您选择的替代异常。
